what: The handoff between the Eye and the rise. On the frames either side of it both places draw the same picture: the banks of cloud over the lake, seen from straight above its centre. The ring numbers are read only by the stand-ins. This file has an identical copy in the other place and a test fails if the two differ.

lid.what: The evening cloud over the socket, over which the cut lies. Both places draw it from these numbers. Lengths are in halves of the height of the view at the cut, heights in heights of the camera at the cut.
